Synopsis:
Laezel can rejoin the party after leaving the player to stay and explore the Creche.

Cluster Contexts:
- Laezel_Recruitment_Creche.json: Lae'zel is a githyanki companion who previously left the party to remain at the crèche/Prism and investigate its rites — she wanted answers and a form of "purification." The player is now inviting her back into the group to enter and scour the crèche together. Lae'zel is terse and driven: she withholds whatever comment she began, but quickly accepts and urges haste. Off‑screen this implies she spent time alone investigating the crèche and that the party is about to move immediately toward that location (this exchange only covers her rejoining, not what she discovered).
- TWN_DeadGithMap_OM_Laezel_AOM_ACM_COM_OOM.json: Laezel tells the player that she will leave to search for the Creche if they don't turn back soon. Variations depending on whether the player has already discovered the Creche or not.
- GLO_Laezel_WRD_ProgressInAct2WithoutCreche.json: Laezel wants to go back to the Creche if you haven't done it.
- Laezel_Recruitment.json: You recruit Lae'zel to the party. She tells you the only path to a cure of the tadpole in your head is to make your way to a githyanki creche - a nursery and training grounds.
- ORI_Laezel_AD_FightOutOfTheCreche.json: Laezel says Vlaakith must have ordered the Creche to kill her. Says  they must fight their way through. If not been to the Zaithisk yet, she says they must go.

Sample 1:
- Lae'zel: So you've seen reason. Truth be told, I'm - (node 40)
- Lae'zel: Never mind. Come with me. We will scour the crèche. I will have answers. (node 13)
- Lae'zel: Never mind. Come with me, and let us be purified. (node 65)
- Player: You were going to say something. Go on, tell me. (node 52)
- Lae'zel: No. (node 16)
- Player: All right. Join me, and let's find this crèche. (node 67)
- Player: All right. Join me, and let's explore the crèche. (node 78)
- Lae'zel: Come, then. Every moment counts. (node 42)

Sample 2:
- Lae'zel: Hurry. We must enter the Prism. (node 23)
- Lae'zel: Hurry. We must explore the crèche - purification awaits. (node 2)
- Player: Agreed. Let's find the crèche and get our cure. (node 7)
- Player: All right. Join me, and let's explore the crèche. (node 78)
- Lae'zel: Come, then. Every moment counts. (node 42)

- Lae'zel: Hurry. We must explore the crèche - purification awaits. (node 2)
- Player: Agreed. Let's group up. (node 55)

context: Lae'zel is a githyanki companion who earlier left the party to remain at the crèche/Prism and investigate its rites, seeking answers and a form of "purification" tied to the party's need for a cure. In this scene the player is inviting her to rejoin the group so they can enter and scour the crèche together; Lae'zel is terse and driven, briefly withholds something she started to say, then quickly accepts. Off‑screen this implies she spent time alone investigating the crèche and that the party is about to move there immediately. This exchange covers only her rejoining — it does not reveal what, if anything, she discovered while apart.
